description: Logs in to a Reddit account with its username and password (plus the TOTP secret when the account has two-factor auth) and returns that account's session cookies (the session cookie, loid, the CSRF cookie and others), the input the connect tool stores server-side. The cookies come back in this tool's result, so they sit in the conversation until they are connected. Reddit sees a real login, which can send the account a login alert. Billed at the login rate. A host built without inline credentials does not list this tool.

method.description: http (default) or browser. browser gives the most compatible write-session cookies.

proxy.description: Sticky IP for this account, http://user:pass@host:port or host:port. The same one belongs on every later call as this account.

totp_secret.description: Base32 TOTP secret, for an account with two-factor auth. Absent when it is off.

name: reddit_login
title: Reddit Account Login
